features: thermal and optical bi-spectrum turret camera with fused/PIP display

release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD1228-7 is a thermal and optical bi-spectrum network turret camera pairing a 256x192 uncooled VOx thermal module (NETD < 40 mK) with a 4 MP optical channel for perimeter protection, fire prevention and temperature-exception alarm. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2TD1228-7_QA_Datasheet_en-US_20231019.pdf.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels.
